title: Song Gain stuns in fusion hanbok on KBS 'Immortal Songs' royal special - CHOSUNBIZ
text:
Song Gain stuns in fusion hanbok on KBS 'Immortal Songs' royal special - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 25일(일) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Song Gain stuns in fusion hanbok on KBS 'Immortal Songs' royal special 
 입력 2026.10.24. 23:20 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Singer Song Gain perfectly pulled off a sophisticated hanbok.
 On the 24th, Song Gain appeared in an outfit befitting KBS2TV's 'Immortal Songs' royal palace special. Standing with the palace wall behind her, Song Gain displayed a refined look with a very distinctive hanbok.
 The jeogori was white silk with a sheen and fit snugly to her body, and the skirt was layered like a muji skirt but made of a sheer material in a pale pink tone that created a creamy effect. The outfit gave her petite frame a fairy-like feel and drew attention. Some call for standardization of Korean hanbok, but by showcasing fusion hanbok style like Song Gain, it can instead highlight hanbok's diversity and bring greater popularization. Song Gain's hanbok look seemed very appropriate for that effect.
 Internet users reacted variously with "The hanbok is worn so beautifully", "As expected, Gain", "Love you" and others.
 Meanwhile, Song Gain has met fans and the public through numerous stages and performances since winning the crown on TV CHOSUN's 'Miss Trot' in 2019.
